# The setuptools that builds pyspark for seed-cold-start-fixture (pyspark publishes only an
# sdist). pip does not check the hashes of the build dependencies it installs in an isolated
# build environment, so the action installs this first and builds without isolation.
#
# Every package and dependency at an exact version, with the SHA-256 of each file PyPI serves
# for it, installed as
#   python -m pip install --require-hashes --only-binary=:all: -r "$GITHUB_ACTION_PATH/../../requirements/cold_start_fixture_build.txt"
# so pip installs these files and nothing else. To change it, regenerate the whole file:
#   printf 'setuptools\n' | uv pip compile - --universal --generate-hashes --no-header \
#     --no-annotate --python-version 3.11 --exclude-newer <a date two weeks back>
# (--exclude-newer keeps each dependency to a release at least two weeks old.)
setuptools==84.2.1 \
    --hash=sha256:3ff8b3b5492a0aa66960f4419365a86b84e013070d4313e4d4a6894f5d64d6bc \
    --hash=sha256:ca140b45d5325a9478f880e351484f62fef15f336462e449ca0c03c873d589c2
